description: A resource envelope bounds the level of a resource over every schedule that the start windows of a flexible plan allow. At each tick, the lower envelope is the lowest level that any schedule can reach and the upper envelope the highest. The verdict is *Safe* (every schedule stays inside the limits), *Possible* (some schedule may break a limit) or *Certain* (every schedule breaks it). For independent windows, the sum of each activity's own extremes gives the tightest envelope. When *precedences* ("this start comes at least so long after that one") link activities, one *minimum cut* in a flow graph gives their joint extreme exactly; with rates or uncertain durations this holds only within a node budget, and above it the result stays safe but may report a false alarm.
